name: Theme picker
description: Omarchy's carousel of theme previews (or palettes), without its dim; typing filters, Enter applies with haseen theme set

placement.description: Where the picker opens: overlay (Omarchy's carousel over the whole screen, with no dim), center (a narrower carousel in a panel in the middle of the screen) or bar (the same in a panel under the bar); in a panel, Escape closes the picker at once, as it does the menu

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.themepicker to drive the open panel without a keyboard
